name: OpenGrid Reference: Germany (OSM)
description: The German transmission network as mapped in OpenStreetMap, via the PyPSA-Eur prebuilt extract (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.13358976 v0.3, ODbL). Topology, coordinates, voltages, circuit counts and line routes are from the source. Every electrical parameter — r, x, b and thermal rating — is ESTIMATED from voltage class and length; the source contains none. See parameters.json for the rule and inputs behind each value. No demand and no generation: this is a network, not a system, and it cannot be dispatched as it stands.
